name: Antonio Decaro - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards simplifying and strengthening the carbon border adjustment mechanism
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a plan to simplify the carbon border adjustment mechanism, a charge on carbon-heavy goods entering the EU. It backs the Commission's plan to exempt small importers bringing in under 50 tonnes, which frees about 90 percent of importers while still covering around 99 percent of emissions. Parliament adds two changes: electricity generated in an EEA country's exclusive economic zone and imported directly into the EU is exempt, and the rules on which input materials count are clarified.

- Small importers under 50 tonnes are exempt from the carbon border charge.
- It affects EU importers of carbon-heavy goods, especially small firms.
- Parliament's position now goes to talks with the Council on the final text.
